capability: Act once, last, even after a crash
title: Every step gets a tick.

hook.picture: Close on the whale pushing a refund coin along the line toward a pod. Halfway, the line snaps (a crash) and the whale is knocked back to the start.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The retry sent the refund twice.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many lines, each snapping somewhere. Every restart repeats the paying step. Three restarts, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Each drops an extra coin.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Every restart does the paying again.

stakes.body: Double payments, double emails, double merges. Each one costs money and trust, and has to be clawed back by hand.

solution_hint: Write down each step. Pay once, last.

metaphor.body: Each finished step drops a tick on the line. After a crash the whale resumes from the last tick, not the start, and the paying card waits at the very end behind a gate, so it fires once.

steps.picture: Steps on the line: check, decide, pay. Each finished step drops a tick. The pay card waits at the far end behind a gate.
steps.words: Each finished step is written down.

steps.picture: The line snaps after the second tick. The whale returns, reads the ticks, and resumes from the last one, not the start.
steps.words: After a crash, start from the last tick.
steps.sound: Snap, then the ticks read back softly

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): the pay card passes the gate once and a tick seals it. A second push finds the sealed tick and stops.
steps.words: Paid once, last. The tape remembers.
steps.sound: One bright coin chime, then a seal

steps.picture: The ticks gather into one strip under the line.
steps.sound: A short rising run of ticks

real_case.claim: The jev-tape README says its crash demo (npm run demo:crash) gives 0 duplicate applies, and that a replay of the event history makes 0 TypeSafe POSTs.

honest_limit.picture: Still. A pod gives a wrong 'pay' answer at step two. It gets a tick like any other, and the whole run redraws it perfectly, every time.
honest_limit.words: A wrong answer gets written down too.

not_this.body: Written down is not the same as right.

ending_pattern.body: One coin after a crash: the same snapped line now ends with exactly one coin in the pod's fin.
ending_pattern.callback: The crash that caused a double payment in bar 1 now ends with one coin.

end_belief.body: Write down each step. Act once, last.
